{"content": "import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem and_left (a b : Bool) (h : (a && b) = true) : a = true := by
  cases a
  case false => cases h
  case true => rfl

theorem and_right (a b : Bool) (h : (a && b) = true) : b = true := by
  cases a
  case false => cases h
  case true =>
    cases b
    case false => cases h
    case true => rfl

theorem dec_true (b : Bool) (h : decide (b = true) = true) : b = true := by
  cases b
  case false => cases h
  case true => rfl

theorem or_right (a b : Bool) (h : (a || b) = true) (ha : a = false) : b = true := by
  cases a
  case false =>
    cases b
    case false => cases h
    case true => rfl
  case true => rw [ha] at *
    cases h

end Solution
"}
